book.name: Rom
book.title: Pol nainge tup nal lenge Rom

content: Got ka ende ŋaimune ŋaiye kin ŋanange
Lenge miyeꞌ Juta yengelyembe lenge haiten taꞌe la? Yaŋah ŋaiye tinge Juta yotombo wahriꞌ hiꞌ pe, ki nungwisme lenge miyeꞌ, lakai pakai?
Hei, bwore mise, lahmende ŋaiye yarp taꞌe lenge Juta miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, Got nangange ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore. Ŋendehei Got nangange wusyep kin uku ŋaiye tinge ka bepyeteme.

Mise, lenge mitiŋ Juta syeꞌ, ŋoihmbwaip tinge yukur teŋeime Got pe, tinge yoworꞌe wusyep tupwaiꞌ ŋaiye tinge yupwaiꞌe topoꞌe Got. Pe luku ka tuꞌe la, Got ka oworꞌe wusyep tupwaiꞌ kin ŋaiye kin si nupwaiꞌe ŋotop tinge lakai?
Got yukur ka se ende tuꞌe liki. Ŋaiye mitiŋ lalme ŋaiye yarp kekep eꞌe pe, tinge pupwa miyeꞌ homboꞌe, kom Got kin bwore mise. Ki taꞌe wusyep ŋaiye sai nato tup ŋanange,

content.text: Tinge ka sisyeme nange ŋaimune ŋaiye nin ŋanange ki bwore mise.
Topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge se ka yende wusyep kot me nin,
kom nin se na yohe.

content: Kom lenge miyeꞌ syeꞌ se ka yininge na, “Ŋupe ŋaiye poi mende hwap pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge se ka yetekeꞌ yoworme ŋaiye Got kin bwore bwarme supule.” Taꞌe luku pe, ya se mininge wusyep uku tuꞌe la? Miyeꞌ syeꞌ se ka yininge na, “Got ŋende pupwa ŋupe ŋaiye ki ŋende wusyep me poi.” Ŋam manange wusyep eꞌe ŋahilyeh taꞌe lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yanange.
Kom wusyep tinge yukur mise. Got kin bwore bwarme supule, topoꞌe wusyep kot ŋaiye kin se ka ende elme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ki bwore bwarme supule.

Lenge miyeꞌ molohe syeꞌ, tinge yanange na, “Wusyep molohe poi ka ende yirise tikin Got ka tus halhale, topoꞌe ki sasambe nange Got kin bwore bwarme supule. De taꞌe lai ti ka gil ŋam nange ŋam miyeꞌ pupwa no, ka ember yitini pupwa otme ŋam?”

Detaꞌe lai ŋai me miyeꞌ molohe syeꞌ ka yininge na, “Ya mende hwap pupwa pupwa menge mil no, ka ende Got ka ambaꞌe naŋ embere.” Lenge miyeꞌ syeꞌ yana ŋam wusyep tetehei pupwa nange wusyep ŋaiye ŋam manange malaŋatme pe, ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe wusyep pupwa luku. Got se ka ende wusyep kot me lenge miyeꞌ uku ŋaiye yanange wusyep uku pe, ka angange yitini pupwa elme tinge ilyeh ilyeh gunde wusyep tinge.
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme yahraꞌe yende hwap

Bwore! Ŋaiye taꞌe luku pe, poi Juta si bwore supule mengelyembe lenge mitiŋ lalme lakai? Pakai supule! Ŋam si manange wusyep uku malme yip me hwap pupwa pupwa tikin ŋaiye nupwaiꞌe poi lalme. Poi ŋaiye Juta topoꞌe lenge mitiŋ ŋaiye yukur Juta.
Wusyep tikin Got ŋaiye sai nato tup pe, ki ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Yukur miyeꞌ ende bwore bwarme, pakai supule.
Yukur miyeꞌ ende ka se ambaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip bwore no,
ka orp bworerme.
Topoꞌe yukur miyeꞌ ende ŋende wah ŋaiye nahaiꞌe Got.
Mitiŋ lalme si yasme yaŋah bwore.
Tinge lalme ŋahilyeh, tinge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yende pupwa.
Ŋende tinge yukur ŋende ŋaimune gande ŋoihmbwaip
ŋaiye bwore bwore. Pakai supule.
Mut tinge naihe taꞌe misip pupwa
ŋaiye naihe ŋuruwih nase ŋeheh nanah.
Wusyep molohe paparar sai mute hip tinge.
Ŋilim tinge tikin papararme wusyep pupwa
ŋaiye tikin ŋende yumbune lenge miyeꞌ.
Ki taꞌe loumwah tikin hwaŋ gunuhwarm.
Nye nyermbe tinge yanange wusyep ŋilim pupwa
yende yumbune lenge mitiŋ syeꞌ,
topoꞌe yangange lenge ŋoihmbwaip mane.
Nye nyermbe tinge jertenge yal
ŋaiye ka yongomb lenge miyeꞌ ka yule.
Ŋupe ŋaiye tinge yalꞌe yalꞌe pe,
tinge yende yumbune ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pe,
tinge yangange lenge ŋoihmbwaip syohe topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip mane.
Tinge yukur sisyeme yaŋah ŋaiye yarp ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye.
Tinge yukur hiꞌjarnge Got, topoꞌe tinge tale naŋ kin.

content: Tukwini poi sisyeme nange wusyep lalme ŋaiye tinge yainge sai nato wusyep erŋeme luku pe, ki ŋanange nalme mitiŋ ŋaiye yarp tuwihme wusyep erŋeme. Taꞌe luku pe, yukur miyeꞌ ende ka se ininge nange kin bwore bwarme, pakai supule. Poi mitiŋ lalme si mende hwap malme Got pe, ka ende wusyep kot me poi.
Miyeꞌ ende yukur tatame ka se orp bwore bwarme el ŋembep tikin Got gunde wusyep erŋeme tikin Got. Wusyep erŋeme ki pasam poi hwap ŋaiye poi mende.
Tehei ŋaiye Got gal lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge nange tinge si bwore bwarme

Kom tukwini Got si pasam poi yaŋah ŋoinde ŋaiye ya murp bwore bwarme mil ŋembep kin. Kom yukur kin nat gande yaŋah ŋaiye jande wusyep erŋeme, pakai. Kin nat gande yaŋah ŋaiye somohonme Got nupwaiꞌe wusyep sai nato tup ŋaiye lenge profet yainge.

Ŋupe ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime Krais Jisas ŋaiye ka ongohe ŋoihmbwaip pupwa poi pe, poi si bwore bwarme mal ŋembep tikin Got. Kin ŋende taꞌe luku nalme poi lalme ŋaiye maŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip poi malme Krais. Yaŋah ŋoinde yukur sai topoꞌe, pakai.
Poi lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme, poi si mende hwap pe, poi yukur tatame ya mi gure wutuꞌ tikin yirise ŋaiye Got nalaŋatme.
Kom Got ki ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ me poi pe, kin pwal poi Krais Jisas pakaiye pe, wah tikin Krais nongohe pupwa poi no, Got nalaŋatme poi nange poi lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye si bwore bwarme.

Got nember Jisas nat ŋaiye ka ole no, wim kin ka turuꞌ ote guh ongohe hwap poi ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip poi ka teŋeime kin. Got ŋende taꞌe luku gande ŋoihmbwaip bwore kin. Somohon Got nenge ŋembep ŋetekeꞌ lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, yukur kin nember yitini pupwa hihwaiye natme lenge mitiŋ ŋaiye yende hwap.

Kom tukwini ŋup eꞌe pe, Got pasam nange kin bwore bwarme supule. Taꞌe luku pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime Jisas pe, Got galme tinge nange tinge si bwore bwarme. Tehei kin taꞌe leꞌe, ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwarme tikin Got si tas halhale.

Ki taꞌe la? Tatame ŋaiye ya gute bip mahraꞌe naŋ poi? Pakai supule! Pe luku ki taꞌe la? Luku ki taꞌe ŋaiye ya gunde wusyep erŋeme? Pakai! Kut ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip poi ka teŋeime Lahmborenge pe, Got ka gil poi bwore bwarme.
Taꞌe luku pe, ya mininge tuꞌe leꞌe. Poi si marp bwore bwarme mal ŋembep tikin Got gwande yaŋah ŋaiye poi maŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip poi malme Jisas, yukur yaŋah ŋaiye jande wusyep erŋeme.
O ki taꞌe la? Got ilyeh uku pe, kin Got lenge Juta ilyehme? Taꞌe kin yukur Got lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge, lakai pakai? Hei, kin Got lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge topoꞌe kili.

Got kin ŋilyehe sai. Kin nambaꞌ lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme gande yaŋah sep ilyeh ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime Jisas. Kin yukur gonose lahmende ŋaiye tinge haiten lakai Juta. Kin nambaꞌe tinge lalme nat yaŋah ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime Krais.
Taꞌe luku pe, yukur ya ŋoihsipe wusyep erŋeme, kut ŋoihmbwaip poi ka teŋeime Krais ilyehme! Na pakai! Poi ya murpe wusyep erŋeme topoꞌe.
